content: Jesus barasam
Week ko day 1 mu te, tirom biyala, imetari mu barasaman, mel siring yawara yawara nunguru beteman se aniram mu giman, ale ali motam te namaman.
Ale manga biya mutim kuring te baguman mu gurugu due ko beteman se arigiman.
Ale ningi kasu naguman, bare Kari Biya Jesus ko kumik guang mutim ningi me arigiman.
Ale nuna ko nungamin tugu se bagaman se me kam la, kari ilagala nunga guang nikinang biya ago mu nongorak sanamaman.
Se imetari mu nguangaman ale nomoke ali ningi kaparam. Bare kari ilagala mu nunga manorman, “Nina anape ko kari barasam marak bagoso wore ko, aking kuera mutim ningi loaga lagasan?
Nu ewela me bagoso. Nu maingkala barasam! Nina noko den Galilee baga se ninga maonam uwutata:
‘Kari ko Namar mu kari memek nuguting te betemon se tam kangono te tagimon se kueruk, ale tom ilagala suan buring ko mu nu marak sokel ago barasukko,’ balam, uwutata.”
Asele nuna noko den umu ko nungamin ares mam.
Se nuna ali motam beteman ale peleman namaman ale olekem 11, se olekem saki agotala, mu mel suen la aratam mu ko nunga manorman se ikiman.
Imetari umu Maria, nu Magdala imet, se bo Joanna, se bo Maria, James ko nuam, se imet saki karogo den imi apostle alo nunga manarukasan.
Bare nuna imetari mu nunga den mu mel yam ko bitakasan, ale ko nongomang ningi me nunguning akaso.
Bare Peter barasam ale ali motam te naguram namaram. Ale tararam ningi loagaram, guang te kaloman mu la aniram se arigam. Ale peleram kuamin yena yena namakaso.
Kari ilagala Emmaus lage karoman namakasan
Tom tegeta umu te la mu nunga kari ilagala mu Emmaus namamonko lage karoman namakasan. Jerusalem nama Emmaus mu 11 kilometre iwita.
Nuna aolak iluman nama se, mel suen biya aratam wore ko duap balu gurugu gurugu se namakasan.
Nuna uwutata balu se namawaman se Jesus me kam la nongote tairam, ale arungak aolak iluwam namakaso.
Bare nuna nu me ko ari ikikasan.
Se nu nunga isuam, “Nina aolak ilu se anape balu lagasan a?” mam. Se nuna pila sanamaman bare nongoma nia mo kam.
Se bo, ko nup Cleopas, mu nu isuam, “Ni taira kari keta suanta Jerusalem ningi mel ekela ulengko aratam mu me ko ikisam agila?” mam.

Se nu nunga isuam, “Anape mel a?” mam. Se ilagala mu nu manorman, “Jesus Nazareth kari wore kumik te mel aratam wore,” maman. “Nu prophet bo, se nu Kaem koma te se kariimet nomokete ura sokel ago bitakaso, ale den sokel ago balukaso.
Bare priest bibiya se anananga kari supuling alo nu iluman, ale den te beteman, ale governor kuting te beteman se kuerukko balam. Se tam kangono te tagiman se kueram.
Bare ana ikikasan mu nu kari borta Israel nunga sangaru taukko kari. “Bare mu la mena, mel aratam umu aitak ko day tom 3 aram.
Se mel bo tala aking aratam mu, anananga imet sang aitakta tirom biyala ali motam te namaman ale anapeya arigiman ale taiman balman mu ana nangamang parusuwuman:
nuna ko kumik guang me arigiman, bare taiman nanga manorman, nuna engel ilagala nungarkaman, se nuna nunga manorman nu barasam ale aitak marak bagoso maman.
Se anananga kari sikina ali motam te namaman mu mel imet balman butatala arigiman. Bare nu kota mu me arigiman.”
Se nu nunga maonam, “Nenenga ikia mu am ngualara biya aniso, se ninga nengemang motam mel prophet alo ko balman mu ko nengemang ningi nunguning arukko mu am ikup biya!
Nuna wetang te tala balman, Kristus girok ikup yaman imi giok ale asele, noko nup biya nikim ago mu taukko.”
Ale Moses te duap beteram, ale prophet saki noko kumik ko den suen la aguwaya balman se aniso mu nunga manarukaso.
Nuna aolak iluman nama wonong te namakasan mu te arataman, bare Jesus wonong mu am ilu kiarukko yam beteram,
se nuna manaru diruwuman, “Sor awuru iluwam ale tirom batagoso, tair ana nangarak anirko!” maman. Se nu turom umu nongorak bagarukko namaram.
Se na namonko kam, se nu bread tam ale Kaem amilmil tuam, ale paogam ale nungaram.
Umu te nononga ikia sinar wiram se ko ikiman mu nuguta, bare nu nomotam ningi am mena namaram.
Se ilagala nunumi manarukasan, “Nunguningta, ana nangarak aolak ilu se nu prophet nunga batoga ko duap nanga manarukaso mu ana nangamang motam ninguru pitigiram!” makasan.
Nuna umu am patma barasaman mu peleman Jerusalem namakasan. Ale umu te mu nuna kari 11 se saki ago biguwuman bagaman mu nongote nama arataman.
Se olekem alo mu balukasan, “Kari Biya nunguningta barasam! Nu Simon-Peter kote aratam se arigam,” makasan, ale ko dugu duap balu gurugukasan mu ikiman.
Asele nuna ilagala mu mel suen la lage te aratam mu ko dugu duap nunga manorman. Ale munan Jesus bread te beteram asele nuna nunga ikia sinararam mu agotala balman.
Jesus ko olekem alo nongote aratam
Nuna mel umu ko am balu guruguwaman se Jesus nunga kusumuri aratu sanamaram ale mam, “Nengemang lila te bagaralko,” mam.
Se nuna ninguru tengeman, ale wit mairap bo arigiman i makasan, ale ninguru nguangakasan.
Bare nu nunga maonam, “Nina anape ko nguangasan ale ningamin namoso taiso ya?” mam.
“Aninga agiting asiwik arigalko, imi anigita pa! Angimik kau tal ale arigalko; wit mairap mu kumik nunguning se kumik sokelel mena, bare ani mu suwuta mena.”
Nu uwutata balam, ale ko suwik kuting nil kuruwim karogo mu nunga kausam se arigiman.
Bare nungamin yenera amilmil ningi, nongomang motam ninguru me nunguning akaso, se nu nunga isuam, “Na i nalko ewela ago e?” mam.
Se nuna wal kaiya mu bilik sang tuman,
se nu tam ale nomokete nokaso.

Nu nunga maonam, “Mel aratukko ewerta, ani nengerak baga se ninga manarukasam: Den suen la ani ago ko Moses ko batoga te, se Prophet nunga batoga te, se Psalm ko batoga te, ani angimik te aratukko mu ko nunguning aratam ta imitang.”
Se nu nunga ikia sinar awuram, se batoga den te aniso mu ko sinarman.
Nu nunga maonam, “Batoga te iwita aniso: Kristus yaman tauk ale kueruk, ale day tom ilagala se suan mu te aking barasukko;
se nengemang guruga se ninga memek siwu ningara ko den mu Jerusalem apura duap betemon, se sor suen la te namarukko,” mu nunga maonam.
Ale mam, “Nina mel suen la aratam imi mu nemetam te arigiman ale ko ikiman, uwutata namaral ale ko balalko.

Bare ani Sangam bo aga Ait ningarukko balam mu bitirik se nengete tai kaparukko. Buta se nina wonong biya me beteral, am bagaral se sokel kualala ko mu tairuk ningimik karogo lilimaruk asele ura duap beteralko,” mam.
Jesus duruk wonong te peleram nama tarigiram
Asele nu nongorak aratam nama Bethany koma mu te arataman. Ale kuting patawuram ale marak nungaram.
Nu marak nungaru se eng barasam nunga beteram ale duruk wonong te nama tarigiram.
Se nuna nup perr tuikasan, ale nongomang ningi amilmil biyala ago peleman Jerusalem namaman.
Ale tom suen biya mu temple ningi la baga se Kaem nup patawukasan.

footnotes.text: Kristus ikup yaman giokko den: Psalm 22:1-21; Isaiah 53.
Bur Laili tai kaparukko: John 15:26; 16:7; Acts 1:4.
